judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `sessions`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `SessionListMessage`) instead of the required `list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, and `ConversationListMessage` specified in the ticket. It completely omitted the opt-in configuration `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` (default off), instead serving conversation lists unconditionally. Validation for `limit` accepts `0` and values above `200`, violating the explicit acceptance criterion that `limit: 0` and `limit: 201` must be rejected as invalid (1-200 integer range). The candidate also modified existing lines in `src/types/messages.ts` despite the acceptance criterion that `git diff` of that file touches no existing line, logged the raw store error message (which could leak connection strings/credentials) instead of omitting store details, failed to update `MongoSessionStore` to throw `StoreCannotList`, and skipped the required updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`.
